text: Pediatrics is an important branch of clinical medicine, with the growth and development, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment of children and adolescents aged 0-18 as its core. The course focuses on the physical, psychological and social development characteristics of children, emphasizing the differences between pediatric diseases and adult diseases (such as immature immune systems and special medication dosages), and cultivating students' abilities in diagnosing and treating common pediatric diseases, rescuing critically ill patients and managing children's health care. At the same time, it establishes the humanistic care concept of "child-centered".
